# Safety and output boundaries

The skill repository is an instruction package only. Create the downstream exercise only in a safe, caller-selected destination that is new or empty and outside this repository; do not overwrite existing work.

Use synthetic data and fictional identities throughout. The exercise may intentionally model unsafe legacy decisions for learning, but it is not an airline service and must not be used with real passenger data, credentials, or public deployment. Keep any optional connected runtime local and isolated.

Use only open-source libraries, components, and frameworks in generated output, and include the applicable license notices and attributions there. Do not copy unlicensed images, fonts, or other assets. A code or readiness smoke check is not evidence that a learner completed a quest.
